answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity is tied to a human operator via a signed, off-chain attestation verified at registration. If a cluster of wallets is flagged as one controller, the operator's escrow is slashed per duplicate identity, and their ability to spawn new identities is throttled. A sybil voyage costs the operator their escrow plus a rising fee. Honest operators on any island face no charge; the nebula of fake wallets collapses because the human pays, not the wallet.
